_comment: Current CPU evidence for the eight integration-ci suites the test: retune integration-ci CPU budgets (444793df0d) raised. The retune changed the COVERED profile block of test/lib/test-cpu-budgets.json (never the plain block, never tightening any budget). Every margin here is computed as retunedCoveredBudget / observedCoveredCpuMs - 1, pairing the observed covered-profile CPU with the retuned covered budget. AGENTS.md / ADR 0063 requires retuning from current CPU evidence with explicit margin; no budget was tightened. Observed CPU is the max inclusive CPU of the heaviest case in each suite, measured under the repository CPU accounting (test/lib/integration-cpu-hook.mjs).

measurement.method: max inclusive CPU (user+system+waited children) of the heaviest case per suite, via integration-cpu-hook.mjs
measurement.baselineSource: test/lib/test-cpu-budgets.json covered block at diff baseline (parent of 444793df0d)
